variants.title: Langmuir probe in the argon discharge at low pressure
variants.sample: Argon DC glow discharge, about 3 Pa
variants.note: At low pressure the electrons are hotter and the plasma thinner. Te = 4.2 eV, ne = 5 x 10^15 per cubic metre, Vp = 10 V are the lab's own numbers for this condition.

source.title: Illustrative design values
source.note: set by the lab for this condition; not taken from a named instrument's datasheet

variants.title: Langmuir probe in the argon discharge at high pressure
variants.sample: Argon DC glow discharge, about 30 Pa
variants.note: At higher pressure the electrons lose more energy in collisions and are cooler. Te = 1.8 eV, ne = 2 x 10^16 per cubic metre, Vp = 6 V are the lab's own numbers for this condition.

source.title: Illustrative design values
source.note: set by the lab for this condition; not taken from a named instrument's datasheet

variants.title: Langmuir probe in the argon discharge at higher power
variants.sample: Argon DC glow discharge, about 10 Pa, more discharge current
variants.note: More discharge current makes more plasma at the same temperature: ne = 4 x 10^16 per cubic metre, Te = 3.2 eV, Vp = 9 V are the lab's own numbers.

source.title: Illustrative design values
source.note: set by the lab for this condition; not taken from a named instrument's datasheet
